retailers.sql: SELECT id, source_key, license_id, display_name, aliases, address, menu_url FROM retailers ORDER BY id

aliases.sql: SELECT lower(entity_type) AS entity_type, observed_name, canonical_name FROM entity_aliases WHERE lower(action) IN ('normalize', 'canonical')

reviews.sql: SELECT entity_type, entity_key, reason FROM review_queue WHERE reason IN ('scanner_new_entity','scanner_identity_uncertain','scanner_retailer_conflict')

add_review.sql: INSERT INTO review_queue (entity_type, entity_key, reason, payload_json) SELECT ?, ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_queue WHERE entity_type = ? AND entity_key = ? AND reason = ?)

add_retailer_menu.sql: UPDATE retailers SET menu_url = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ? AND trim(coalesce(menu_url, '')) = ''

add_retailer.sql: INSERT INTO retailers (source_key, display_name, license_id, address, menu_url, website_url, raw_json) SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retailers WHERE upper(license_id) = ?) ON CONFLICT(source_key) DO NOTHING

add_brand.sql: INSERT INTO brands (canonical_name, research_status, raw_json) VALUES (?, 'needs_review', ?) ON CONFLICT(canonical_name) DO NOTHING

add_strain.sql: INSERT INTO strains (canonical_name, review_status, raw_json) VALUES (?, 'needs_review', ?) ON CONFLICT(canonical_name) DO NOTHING
